subject: Preferred invoice submission channel and sample invoice layout
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preferred invoice submission channel and sample invoice layout

Hi Jane,

Thanks for moving the vendor setup forward. Quick questions from our AP side to make sure invoices route correctly once you're activated:

- Do you prefer to submit invoices via your supplier portal (we can pull via SFTP/API) or send PDFs to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com?
- If email, do you have a single remit address or multiple vendor emails per site?
- Do invoices need PO stamping on our side, or do you accept invoices with our PO number in the body/line-level?
- Do you have a preferred invoice template (PDF vs structured CSV/EDI)? If structured, can you share sample headers for mapping?

Attached is Acme's vendor setup form you returned — I can sync the fields with our AP template if needed. Monica, Laura — looping you in for any technical mapping notes.

Next step: if portal is possible, we can schedule a 30-min handoff with our billing ingestion engineer to confirm field mapping and SFTP/API credentials. If email only, we'll share a naming convention and sample PDF layout to avoid delays.

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Cc: ACME Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preferred invoice submission channel and sample invoice layout

Hi Sergio — thanks for the note. Short answers below: 

- Primary: we prefer invoices via our supplier portal (we can push or you can pull via SFTP).
- Secondary (fallback): PDFs to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com; single remit address is fine.
- PO stamping: We require the PO number on the invoice; line-level PO matching is not required but the PO number must be present and match our PO.
- Template: We prefer structured CSV upload for high-volume suppliers; PDF accepted for ad-hoc. I'll attach our portal spec and a sample CSV header.

We do not use EDI at this time.

Jane
Director, Supplier Operations
Acme Corp
jane.doe@acmecorp.com
Attachment: acme_portal_spec_20260322.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
Attachment: acme_sample_csv_headers.csv (text/csv, 1KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preferred invoice submission channel and sample invoice layout

Thanks Jane — that's helpful. A few items from our AP ingestion side (to make mapping smooth):

Required fields for automated ingest (CSV or API pull):
- Supplier legal name (must match vendor record)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
- Total amount (currency specified)
- PO number (our PO number field)
- Line-level description, quantity, unit price (optional but preferred)
- Remit address (for non-portal payment exceptions)

If you can provide the CSV header order we can map programmatically. If using the portal/SFTP, please include a checksum manifest (we reconcile counts). For email/PDF fallback: we ask that the PDF filename include the PO and invoice number (example: PO12345_INV67890.pdf) and that PDFs be one invoice per PDF to avoid split/merge errors.

I've attached our recommended invoice template (redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) — it's a simple mapping we can accept as CSV export.

Next steps I propose:
1) Jane, can your portal team provide SFTP credentials or an API endpoint for a sandbox copy?
2) If not ready this quarter, we'll accept email with the filename convention above.
3) Once we have a sample CSV export, our billing engineer will run a 1-hour mapping session and a test ingest (two sample invoices) before going live.

Laura and I will track the M.A.P. and confirm dates.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Payments Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 18KB)

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preferred invoice submission channel and sample invoice layout

Hi Monica — quick follow-ups from our technical lead after reviewing your template: 

- For PDF fallback: the single-invoice-per-PDF filename rule is fine.
- SFTP: we can provide sandbox SFTP credentials; will require a short agreement for access (we'll send a DocuSign link).
- CSV headers: our export includes these columns: supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, invoice_number, invoice_date, currency, line_id, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, invoice_total, po_number, remit_address. Is that order okay for you?
- About taxes: we include VAT/GST columns as separate line-level fields; if Redwood needs consolidated tax lines, we can add an invoice_tax_total column.

Also asking whether Redwood supports incremental ingest (append only) vs full replace per file. Our export will be append-style (new invoices only).

I'll send the SFTP agreement and the sandbox creds once the DocuSign is signed.

Best,
Jane

Jane — great, thanks for the clarity and for offering the sandbox. Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and owners: 

- By 2026-03-26: Acme to send signed SFTP access agreement (Jane) — DocuSign link to follow.
- By 2026-03-30: Acme to provide sandbox SFTP creds and two sample CSV exports (Jane).
- By 2026-04-02: Redwood Billing Engineer to run mapping session + ingest two samples in sandbox (Monica).
- By 2026-04-06: Confirm go-live date for production ingest (Laura) — aim for 2026-04-12 if tests pass.

Karthik — I'm copying you for PO/process questions: once live, will Redwood require PO stamping on the PDF we produce, or is including the PO number on export sufficient for AP reconciliation? Karthik: recommend confirming whether finance needs invoice files stored in a particular archive path for audit (we maintain 7 years by default).

Jane — we'll send the DocuSign link for the SFTP agreement today and include a short checklist for the sandbox deliverables. After the sandbox test, we'll schedule a 30-min post-mortem to capture any mapping edge cases (tax line consolidation, multi-currency rounding).

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth onboarding.

Sergio
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
